observations:
NASDAQ 13 unique orig trades (Wed7 21:25 - Mon12 12:45). Findings, tested on all 13 + the 4 extra_mine setups:
1) SETUP = BREAKOUT CLOSE: impulse bar closes beyond the highest high (long, bull bar) / lowest low (short, bear bar) of the PRIOR 8-9 bars (N=8 or 9 reproduces all 13 orig setups; N<=5 misses Mon 06:15, N>=10 breaks Fri 06:00/Thu 14:25).
2) ENTRY (limit, exact on all 13): long = max(impulse body mid, prior-N-bar high); short = min(body mid, prior-N-bar low), i.e. the broken range edge when it is nearer the close than the body mid. Examples: Thu 08:00 -> 31208.1 (07:55 H), Thu 15:45 -> 30964.5 (15:35 L), Fri 12:50 -> 31000.2 (12:35 H, table-confirmed), Mon 06:15 -> 31006.7 (05:45 L); all others = body mid.
3) FILL: first later bar trading through the entry; pending order can wait at least 3 bars (Wed 21:10 impulse -> 21:25 fill; Thu 08:40 -> 08:50). A later weak breakout bar (Wed 21:15, body 7.1) did NOT replace the pending 21:10 entry.
4) STOP: R = 1.80 x ATR(14, RMA/Wilder) of the impulse bar on 12/13 trades (1.78-1.82). Exception Fri 06:05 long: R=19.5 = 0.90 x ATR (half stop); my clone used 1.8xATR there (stop 30740.7 vs orig 30760.6) - the only stop mismatch; all other matched trades have my stop within 1 px of orig. TP = entry +/- 0.6/1/1.5/2 R; exits at TP4 or stop only.
5) One position at a time (Wed 21:25 long held to Thu 04:45 TP4; breakouts in between ignored). DAILY CAP 5 FILLS: Fri table FILLS/CAP 5/5 after 12:55 (05:00,06:05,09:45,11:10,12:55) -> no orig trades rest of Fri (incl. 19:00-19:10 crash); Thu also had 5 fills (05:40,08:05,08:50,14:30,15:50) -> nothing after 15:50 (19:50/19:55 breakouts skipped). Mon table FILLS 2/5 with 06:20, 11:15. Day apparently starts ~03:30-04:30 IST (Thu 05:40 counts in Thu).
6) SKIPPED setups (my extra trades): Thu 13:25 short (MY 13:30) - close 30979.8 did NOT break the prior-8-bar low (12:45 L30968.4), only a shorter lookback; Fri 07:05 long (MY 07:10) - did not break prior-8-bar high (06:15 H30804.7) and opened BELOW VWAP (straddle); Mon 08:45 short (MY 08:50) - breakout yes but bar opened ABOVE VWAP (+5.8) and closed below (-7.1) -> straddling-VWAP impulse rejected (all 13 taken impulses opened on the trade side of VWAP or within 0.2 of it: Mon 06:15 o-vwap -0.2, Fri 06:00 +1.4); Mon 05:00 long (MY 05:10) - breakout, fully above VWAP, 90 min after Monday open, but impulse range/ATR = 2.00 (largest; taken ones <=1.79) and body/ATR 1.46 -> possible over-extension filter or Monday warm-up; cause unconfirmed.
7) Missed by mine: Wed 21:25 long (21:10 impulse, body 22.8 = 0.70 ATR, close 59 above VWAP, fill 3 bars later), Thu 15:50 short (entry = 15:35 low, not body mid), Fri 12:55 long (entry = 12:35 high) - the latter two need rule 2.
8) Blue circles on the orig VWAP line every 11 bars are cosmetic. Narrow 2-3 bar boxes (Thu 14:30, 15:50) are missed by boxes.py; found with a fill-colour column scan.
